description:
Professional video downloader for YouTube, Twitter, and 50+ platforms with 4K quality support

Video Downloader is a modern Windows desktop application powered by yt-dlp and FFmpeg with a Microsoft Edge WebView2 interface.

Features:
- 4K Ultra HD video downloads (2160p, 1080p, 720p)
- Multi-platform support (YouTube, Twitter, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Twitch, Kick and 50+ sites)
- Subtitle downloads in multiple languages
- Audio extraction to MP3 (up to 320 kbps)
- Real-time download progress with speed and ETA monitoring
- Modern WebView2 interface with dark mode
- Multi-language interface (English and Turkish)
- Automatic FFmpeg installation and configuration
- Privacy-focused with zero data collection
